conditions.name: timeout
conditions.predicate: no selected event; automatic emergencies remain enabled

conditions.name: wave_changed
conditions.predicate: public wave differs from the preceding simulation tick

conditions.name: packet_became_ready
conditions.predicate: new public active nonempty (index,type,imitater_type) tuple compared with the preceding tick; readiness does not imply affordability or a legal cell

conditions.name: sun_increased
conditions.predicate: public sun exceeds the preceding simulation tick

conditions.name: left_zone_occupied
conditions.predicate: any living public on_board zombie has public rendered x <= 160.0; level predicate may already hold at action start

conditions.name: plant_count_decreased
conditions.predicate: number of public plants decreases from the preceding simulation tick; no hidden plant identity

automatic_emergencies.name: defense_lost
automatic_emergencies.predicate: a public (row,type) defense that was READY(state=1) is absent or no longer READY compared with the preceding tick

automatic_emergencies.name: zombie_entered_left_zone
automatic_emergencies.predicate: a new signed public zombie ID joins the living on_board x<=160 set compared with the preceding tick; no hidden allegiance or future-wave input

simultaneous_reporting: all triggered reasons retained in precedence order; first is primary reason
initial_condition_semantics: terminal and already-true left_zone_occupied return zero actual ticks without forced advancement; edge predicates require a subsequent change
coordinate_semantics: x uses exactly the default six-significant-digit public JSON rendering; native private float cannot move the threshold boundary
maximum_duration_semantics: bound the same AdvanceLogicTick calls as legacy WAIT; report actual public board tick delta separately, including stalled clock steps
physical_operation: each native advance calls the existing EnvironmentWait(1); automatic sun collection and simulator update order stay on the existing path
economic_history_semantics: native action returns once; aggregate counters annotated once at its final tick like existing fixed WAIT; no Python micro-step income history
replay_semantics: operation stores exact macro action and wait_result; replay checks interruption metadata in addition to physical state, events and actual duration
fixed_wait_compatibility: fixed WAIT actions retain the old path; the fixed Python environment rejects until; branch batching explicitly rejects until pending complete native batch support
selected_threshold_rationale: 160 public pixels defines a concrete left-zone interruption hypothesis. It is not a victory threshold or an asserted optimal threat detector; freeze before any learning comparison.
